text:
maya: CI alert — macOS bazel build on master started failing after yesterday's .bazelrc tweak. Linux and local builds look fine. Anyone else seeing linkerrors on mac nodes?

buildkite: build #4521 failed on macos-clang-12 (job 7) — https://ci.example.com/builds/4521

maya: paste of the failing linker output:```
/usr/bin/ld: bazel-out/darwin-fastbuild/bin/pkg/libplugin.a(plugin.o): undefined reference to `InitPlugin()'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
Target //pkg/myapp:myapp failed to build
INFO: Elapsed time: 24.31s, Critical Path: 12.45s
```

liam: seeing the same failure in the mac builders. Looks like the symbol is in libplugin but linker isn't pulling it in — could be rpath or linkopt change.

sam: @maya can you paste the last .bazelrc change? I vaguely remember we added a --linkopt=-Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs line yesterday.

maya: yep — we added a couple linkopts in //tools:global_bazelrc to trim unused dylibs. Snip:```
build --linkopt=-Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs
build --linkopt=-Wl,-rpath,@loader_path/../lib
```

jen: that rpath change might be making the dynamic linker ignore static objects during link in some mac SDK combos. Mac linkers are weird about archive ordering + dead_strip. Can someone try flipping back the rpath option? :thinking_face:

liam: quick repro locally using macos toolchain image (docker macos-sim locally): `bazel build //pkg/myapp:myapp --config=darwin-clang` — I can try toggling the linkopts.

ci-bot: rerun requested by jen — restarted build #4522 (macos-clang-12: job 7).

sam: If rerun passes, we're probably hitting flakiness. If it fails consistently, we should bisect the .bazelrc change vs any cc_toolchain changes. @jen can you open a temporary rollback CL for the .bazelrc until we triage?

jen: on it. Making a CL to revert the two linkopts and pin to previous build flags. I'll include a note to revert when we have a solution.

ops-bot: CL 9876 created by jen: "revert: remove mac linkopt rpath/dead_strip until triage" — reviewers: @build-team.

buildkite: build #4522 failed on macos-clang-12 (job 7) — same linker error.

maya: OK it's reproducible. Not flake. Bisect plan: 1) revert linkopts CL to see if that fixes, 2) if not, bisect cc_toolchain changes last 48h, 3) consider ordering change for static libs (add -Wl,-force_load equivalent).

liam: I can run a narrow bisect of recent commits touching //tools:cc_toolchain and //tools:global_bazelrc. Give me a list of commits from the last 2 days that touched those files.

sam: `git log --pretty=oneline --abbrev-commit -- tools/global_bazelrc tools/cc_toolchain | head -n 12` should show candidate commits. I'll DM the hashes to liam.

jen: I've kicked off an internal try job with the revert CL applied to master buildkite (job 9). Will report when it completes.

liam: quick test locally — removed the --linkopt=-Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs and left the rpath alone: build succeeded. Looks like dead_strip is the culprit here (it strips object providing the InitPlugin symbol when it thinks it's unused).

maya: great find. dead_strip got aggressive. Any downside to removing it globally? It was intended to reduce binary size for some customers.

sam: short term: revert dead_strip (jen's CL will do both, ok). Long term: we should gate dead_strip behind a config macro or only enable for release builds. I'll open a follow-up RFC.

jen: FYI build #4530 (try job with revert) succeeded on macos-clang-12. Merging CL 9876 now to stop CI noise.

maya: thanks all. I'll annotate the original config PR with the explanation and link to the follow-up RFC. :white_check_mark:

liam: filing a tiny doc on caveats for --linkopt=-Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs on darwin — will ping the distro owners.

maya: if anyone saw related breakages in other repos, please drop notes. Closing this thread once CI is green across the board.

buildkite: master build #4534: all macos-clang jobs passed.

maya: closing thread — resolved by reverting dead_strip in .bazelrc and planning a gated rollout. Thanks! :tada:
